description: This source file contains C# classes that demonstrate usage of fonts within the PdfSharp library, including font creation, font family construction, font simulation, and rendering examples. It features snippets for different font types and styles, including native, simulated, and private fonts, across multiple platforms (GDI, WPF, etc.).

classes.name: DefaultWindowsFontsSnippet
classes.description: Demonstrates font selection and rendering with Windows fonts, including native and simulated styles.

classes.name: FontFamilyConstructionSnippet
classes.description: Showcases construction of font families and various font styles within the project.

classes.name: PlatformFontConstructionSnippet
classes.description: Illustrates font selection tailored to different platforms (GDI, WPF, UWP) with font family and style variations.

classes.name: HelveticaNeueFontsSnippet
classes.description: Demonstrates usage of the Helvetica Neue font family with various styles and weights.

classes.name: FrutigerFontsSnippet
classes.description: Showcases usage of Frutiger fonts, including native, simulated, and light variants.

classes.name: PrivateFontCollectionSnippet
classes.description: Example of loading and using private fonts embedded as resources.

classes.name: XPrivateFontCollection
classes.description: A helper class/method set for managing private font collections across platforms.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Method to render fonts and font styles on the graphics context.
